content_sections.heading: GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026 Overview
GSL Trainee Project Executive Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Goa Shipyard Limited has announced 31 vacancies for Trainee Project Executive posts in different disciplines.

content_sections.heading: GSL Trainee Project Executive Important Dates 2026
GSL Trainee Project Executive Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the educational qualification and experience requirements mentioned in the official notification. Candidates must have a Full-time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4 Years) in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university/institute. Candidates must have a Full-time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4 Years) in Electrical Engineering from a recognized university/institute. Candidates must have a Full-time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4 Years) in Electronics Engineering from a recognized university/institute. Candidates must have a Full-time Regular B.E./B.Tech/B.Sc. Engineering (4 Years) in Naval Architecture from a recognized university/institute. Candidates must have Graduation along with any one of the following: Qualified Chartered Accountant from ICAI Qualified Cost Accountant from Institute of Cost Accountants of India / ICMA 02 Years PG Diploma / PG Degree in Finance Candidates should possess minimum 1 year relevant experience or one year Graduate Apprenticeship training as on 31 July 2026. Apprenticeship in any industry will also be considered as experience.

content_sections.heading: GSL Trainee Project Executive Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit will be considered as on 31 July 2026. Age relaxation for PwBD and other categories will be provided as per Government guidelines. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: GSL Trainee Project Executive Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive consolidated pay during the contract period.

content_sections.heading: GSL Trainee Project Executive Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee for GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026 is ₹500. The fee is payable online through SBI e-pay. SC/ST candidates are exempted. PwBD candidates are exempted. Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted. GSL Graduate Apprentices and GSL Advance Trainees are exempted.

content_sections.heading: GSL Trainee Project Executive Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following stages: Written Test Document Verification Group Discussion / Interview The written test will consist of 25% General Aptitude questions and 75% subject/trade-related questions. The final grading will be based on Written Test (85%) and Group Discussion/Interview (15%).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official GSL recruitment portal. Visit the Goa Shipyard Limited official website. Go to Notice Board - Careers section. Select the GSL Careers link. Click on Apply Now and choose the desired post. Complete the online application form. Upload required documents and pay the application fee. Submit the application and take a printout for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by Goa Shipyard Limited for engaging Trainee Project Executives on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 31 vacancies are available across Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Finance and Naval Architecture disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates require relevant engineering qualifications for technical disciplines and Graduation with professional finance qualifications for Finance discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of GSL Trainee Project Executive?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from ₹35,000 to ₹40,000 per month depending on the contract year.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 03 October 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for GSL Trainee Project Executive?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Written Test, Document Verification and Group Discussion/Interview.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for GSL Trainee Project Executive Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Goa Shipyard Limited recruitment portal.
